messages:
Samira (Sales AE): AureaHealth needs a 21-day on-prem POC. They2re strict: air-gapped, Vault HSM, and want ephemeral API keys via a bastion. Can we get a short preflight + port list + ballpark pricing?
Devon (Infra Eng): I'll list the critical checks: GPU model/driver, CUDA, kernel, container runtime, k8s version, nvidia device plugin, cgroup mode, SELinux. Also note BIOS NVLink/PCIe settings if relevant.
Rohit (Solutions Eng): Ephemeral key flow (summary): 1) Sales creates scoped POC grant in Console. 2) Console produces signed grant blob. 3) Customer bastion + client certs POST grant to validate endpoint over mTLS. 4) We return short-lived session creds (1-6h).
Maya (FieldTech): For air-gap: we deliver a tarball of images + helm chart and a mirror script. Customer must host a Docker v2 registry (Harbor/Quay/GCR).
AureaHealth-ops: Confirm they support Harbor and Vault on-site. Also want a one-paragraph security note for legal.
Devon (Infra Eng): Security note (short): we never export customer keys. Agent calls Vault transit for encrypt/decrypt; keys remain in customer's HSM. No plaintext keys leave site.
Rohit (Solutions Eng): Quick commands customers can run (non-admin):
```bash
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv
if command -v nvcc >/dev/null; then nvcc --version; fi
uname -r; lsmod | egrep 'nvidia|nvrm' || true
kubectl --context=onprem get nodes -o wide
```
Maya (FieldTech): Ports to document: kube-apiserver 6443, etcd 2379/2380 (if self-hosted), node metrics 9100, DCGM 9400, optional outbound 443 to artifact proxy.
Devon (Infra Eng): Compatibility callouts: kernels <5.4 may need backports for CUDA11.8+, SELinux Enforcing can block mounts (recommend Permissive during install), cgroup v2 may cause runtime issues.
billing-bot: Quote request created: aurea/1882345678 (4x A100-equivalent, 21 days).
Maya (FieldTech): Rough price?
billing-bot: Ballpark: ~$19k pro-rated for 4x A100 for 21 days. Formal quote pending.
AureaHealth-ops: We'll run the checks Tue 08:30 PST and paste outputs here.
Samira (Sales AE): Thanks everyone 2F please get the one-pager and security blurb by EOD so I can send to Aurea legal.
Devon (Infra Eng): Will do 2F I'll include openssl examples for mTLS cert validation.
Rohit (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the ephemeral token FAQ (3 bullets) and attach the mirror instructions.
Samira (Sales AE): Great, closing loop until we have node outputs.
